title: Signal snapshot & manager cues — growth soundboard
content:
Purpose: quick, defensible soundboard for 1:1 + calibration. Keep short — pull the right signals, surface evidence, and practice the asks.

Top-line framing (30s): last 6 months I focused on two areas: (1) improving hire quality & time-to-hire for infra-engineering, (2) running low-friction manager enablement pilots (mentorship + onboarding checklist). Net impact: faster cycle for senior IC hiring (see metric), fewer onboarding follow-ups, and one cross-org cost-win I led.

Key metrics / signals (evidence to cite)
- Time-to-offer (senior infra): baseline Q2 2025 = 42 days -> Q4 2025 = 34 days (-19%). Source: JIRA-HR-312 candidate-tracker dashboard.
- Offer acceptance delta for senior roles: +6pp since structured interview rubric rolled out (candidate pool N=38). See CON-4872 notes.
- Mentor pilot: 14 participants; post-survey NPS +22 (qualitative themes: faster ramp, clearer expectations). Repo: github.com/redwood/reports/pulse-mentorship-run-1.
- Cross-org: reduced contractor overhang by one headcount equivalent through alternative vendor negotiation ($48k annual run-rate saving) — negotiation lead = me.

Impact stories (30-60s each)
1) Hiring rubric adoption: ran two calibration sessions with infra leads, iterated rubric across 6 roles. Example story: candidate X had fuzzy rubric feedback -> we re-scored, reopened interview loop and secured a stronger hire who later owned high-impact storage migration.
2) Manager enablement checklist: compiled recurring ask list, rolled out with Lina to 12 first-time managers; within 6 weeks we saw 37% fewer onboarding help-desk tickets from their teams.

Signals I want the manager to surface in calibration
- That I can own broader hiring program (planning + vendor negotiation) not just execution.
- Readiness to lead a small people ops project with a P&L tie (e.g., hiring vendor consolidation).

Asks (clear, timebound)
1) Sponsor a short pitch to GTM + Eng leads for vendor consolidation pilot (target: decision by end of Q2 2026).
2) Block 2 months of embedded project capacity (0.2 FTE from my org) for running the pilot (May–Jun 2026).
3) Mid-year calibration: ask for promotion packet prep timeline if manager agrees I should be considered (submit draft by Aug 1, 2026).

Risks / counterpoints I want we acknowledge in calibration
- I’m stronger on program execution than analytics; propose a 1-2 month support from someone in Data for rigorous ROI modeling.
- Stakeholder bandwidth: Eng leads are stretched; need manager to help with lift for initial sponsor buy-in.

Practice lines (short scripts)
- On impact: "I ran the hiring rubric and calibration program that shortened our senior time-to-offer by nearly 20% and increased acceptance rates — I’d like to scale that approach to vendor selection to capture $x/year."
- On readiness for bigger scope: "I’m ready to own a cross-functional pilot end-to-end; I’ll scope clear milestones and measurable outcomes and bring a data partner for modeling."

Open follow-ups (todo)
- Pull offer-level dashboard export for Q3–Q4 2025 (Jonah will share by 2026-02-22).
- Draft 1-pager vendor consolidation rationale (me) — deadline 2026-03-05.
- Ask Lina to surface mentor pilot survey excerpts for manager packet (Lina to share 2026-02-24).

Notes to self (private, shorter):
- Calm tone: focus on business outcomes, not activities.
- Avoid over-claiming: tie every story to a metric or stakeholder quote.
- If asked about gaps: propose the data support plan (2 months) and a clear success definition.

Appendix snippets to copy into 1-pager or promotion packet
- "Reduced TtO for senior infra from 42d to 34d by introducing structured rubric + targeted calibration sessions (N=16 hires touched)."
- Quote from Eng lead: "Meera’s calibration session clarified expectations — we hired faster and with fewer mismatches." (Jonah to vouch).

Status: bundle into a 1-page to share in 1:1 on 2026-02-25 and iterate after manager feedback.

End.
